\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 183-186 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:LA-R191-first-pass-words-from-chapters-183-186}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a storm and a rain cloud.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item known, famous, honourable, middle, highest
  \item wasteful, moderate, eloquent, mute, lame
  \item a storeroom, a study, a colonnaded garden, a rain basin, a foundation
  \item a helmsman, a market, a weight, a measure, a pound; a pair of scales
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Known? (\textbf{nōtus, nōta, nōtum}.) Famous? (\textbf{celeber, celebris, celebre}.) Honourable? (\textbf{honestus, honesta, honestum}.) Middle? (\textbf{medius, media, medium}.) Highest? (\textbf{summus, summa, summum}.) Wasteful? (\textbf{prōdigus, prōdiga, prōdigum}.) Moderate? (\textbf{modestus, modesta, modestum}.) Eloquent? (\textbf{fācundus, fācunda, fācundum}.) Mute? (\textbf{mūtus, mūta, mūtum}.) Lame? (\textbf{claudus, clauda, claudum}.) A storeroom? (\textbf{cella, cellae}.) A study? (\textbf{tablīnum, tablīnī}.) A colonnaded garden? (\textbf{peristylium, peristyliī}.) A rain basin? (\textbf{impluvium, impluviī}.) A foundation? (\textbf{fundāmentum, fundāmentī}.) A helmsman? (\textbf{gubernātor, gubernātōris}.) A market? (\textbf{mercātus, mercātūs}.) A weight? (\textbf{pondus, ponderis}.) A measure? (\textbf{mēnsūra, mēnsūrae}.) A pound; a pair of scales? (\textbf{lībra, lībrae}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 187-191 — a second pass}

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item peace, a leader, victory, freedom, glory
  \item an architect, a weaver, a potter, a farm manager, a tenant farmer
  \item a blood relative, a mother's brother, a mother's sister, truth, a lie
  \item a tax, a tribute, wages, a denarius, a sesterce
  \item charcoal, a crag, a constellation, a storm, a rain cloud
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Peace? (\textbf{pāx, pācis}.) A leader? (\textbf{dux, ducis}.) Victory? (\textbf{victōria, victōriae}.) Freedom? (\textbf{lībertās, lībertātis}.) Glory? (\textbf{glōria, glōriae}.) An architect? (\textbf{architectus, architectī}.) A weaver? (\textbf{textor, textōris}.) A potter? (\textbf{figulus, figulī}.) A farm manager? (\textbf{vīlicus, vīlicī}.) A tenant farmer? (\textbf{colōnus, colōnī}.) A blood relative? (\textbf{cognātus, cognātī}.) A mother's brother? (\textbf{avunculus, avunculī}.) A mother's sister? (\textbf{mātertera, māterterae}.) Truth? (\textbf{vēritās, vēritātis}.) A lie? (\textbf{mendācium, mendāciī}.) A tax? (\textbf{vectīgal, vectīgālis}.) A tribute? (\textbf{tribūtum, tribūtī}.) Wages? (\textbf{mercēs, mercēdis}.) A denarius? (\textbf{dēnārius, dēnāriī}.) A sesterce? (\textbf{sēstertius, sēstertiī}.) Charcoal? (\textbf{carbō, carbōnis}.) A crag? (\textbf{scopulus, scopulī}.) A constellation? (\textbf{sīdus, sīderis}.) A storm? (\textbf{procella, procellae}.) A rain cloud? (\textbf{nimbus, nimbī}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
